text:
Alex K: FYI eu-west1 blackbox streaming probes tripped several alerts in the 30m window — saw a cluster of packet drops and an uptick in kv-cache misses. not seeing user traffic spike.

SRE Bot: Alert fired: streaming-endpoint-3xx-rate > 1% (eu-west1) — group: streaming-endpoints — runbook: https://redwood.example/runbooks/streaming-failures

Jamie L: are those probes replaying full conversations? curious how many synthetic tokens we're burning.

Kevin H: quick billing grab: current synthetic probes across regions ~450M tokens/month -> ~ $2.7k/mo. eu-west1 alone ~35% of probe tokens.

Priya S: rough proposal: tier the probes by signal to cut cost and noise:
- light health: TCP/HTTP 200 + latency ping, every 15s
- stream sanity: websocket open + 5s of data, every 2m
- heavy replay: full convo / 512-token embedding, once per 10m per region

Alex K: + adaptive behavior: if failure rate > 0.5% in last 5m then escalate to heavy checks for that region; otherwise keep light checks. reduces steady-state cost.

Maria G: ops note for dashboards: we need a `probe="true"` label on all synthetic traffic so PromQL excludes probes from customer SLOs and histograms. current SLO panels double-count probe latency.

Jamie L: can heavy probes be shortened? instead of 512-token embedding replay, send a 64-token synthetic embedding that still exercises kv-cache/quant path.

Kevin H: good idea. also tag probe traffic with billing tag `probe=true` so we can separate cost center and set budget alerts.

Priya S: proposed Prom rules to implement (draft):
```
# label probes in client lib
redwood_request_total{probe="true"}

# customer latency (exclude probes)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{probe!="true"}[5m])))
```

Maria G: Grafana: add panels showing probe vs customer latency, probe token burn rate, and a small panel for kv-cache misses by region. then tune alert thresholds to ignore short flaps caused by probes.

Alex K: also consider scheduling heavy replays during local off-peak windows per region (eu-west1 02:00-05:00 local) so if something noisy happens we don't hit cost spikes.

DeployBot: Probe config v2 pushed to staging: /configs/probes/eu-west1.yaml — will roll to prod after approvals.

Kevin H: I can add a daily cost report for probe tokens to the infra-costs dashboard. helps product/QA justify test traffic.

Priya S: I'll open a small PR to the probe lib to add `probe=true` labeling, short/long probe modes, and the adaptive backoff logic.

Alex K: thanks — priority: label probes, reduce heavy frequency, implement adaptive escalation, and update dashboards. can we aim to roll within 48h? :thumbsup!
